definitions.gloss: texture of food; mouthfeel; how food feels when eating
definitions.explanation: The tactile sensations experienced when eating food, including crunchiness, chewiness, smoothness, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食感|しょっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦サクサクしている→サクサクする：26949_sakusakusuru⟧。
examples.english: These cookies have a crispy texture.

examples.japanese: {食感|しょっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat it raw to enjoy the texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{食感|しょっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧です。
examples.english: Its characteristic is the chewy, springy texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サクサク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食感|しょっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Crispy texture is everything for tempura, so eating it freshly fried is best.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧シャキシャキ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{食感|しょっかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔|やわ}らかさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶妙|ぜつみょう}→絶妙：13812_zetsumyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This dish has a perfect balance between the crisp crunch of the vegetables and the tenderness of the meat.

notes:
{食感|しょっかん} combines {食|しょく} (eating) and ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sensation): how food feels in the mouth, as distinct from how it tastes. Japanese food writing treats texture as a dimension of quality in its own right, so the word is everywhere in reviews, packaging, and cooking programs.

COMMON TEXTURE WORDS:
- サクサク (crispy, crunchy — dry foods)
- カリカリ (crunchy, crisp — fried foods)
- ⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧ (chewy, springy — rice, mochi)
- ⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧ (fluffy, soft — bread, cakes)
- ⟦とろとろ→とろとろ：05257_torotoro⟧ (melty, creamy)
- ⟦しっとり→しっとり：05837_shittori⟧ (moist)
- プリプリ (bouncy, firm — shrimp, seafood)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{舌触|したざわ}り→舌触り：07919_shitazawari⟧: how food feels specifically on the tongue
- ⟦{歯応|はごた}え→歯応え：07272_hagotae⟧: resistance when biting, one component of {食感|しょっかん}
- {食感|しょっかん} is the general term covering all of these mouthfeel sensations
